# Alex Warren Takes On New York City for Exclusive SiriusXM Small Stage Series Concert


November 19, 2026 10:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_e380adda605e9e1bec45f246bdd7c6b4/siriusxm/news/2026-11-19_Alex_Warren_Takes_On_New_York_City_for_Exclusive_2324.pdf)


***Intimate performance on December 10 at Irving Plaza to air on SiriusXM Hits 1***


**NEW YORK – November 19, 2026 –** SiriusXM today announced that GRAMMY *®* -nominated, multi-platinum songwriter and musician **Alex Warren** will bring his biggest hits to New York City for a special SiriusXM show on December 10 at Irving Plaza.


As part of SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series presented by *REESE’S* , the intimate performance will bring fans closer than ever to Alex Warren as he delivers an unforgettable night of music featuring songs from his latest album, *WILDCHILD* , and his biggest chart-topping hits.


SiriusXM subscribers can tune in to hear the performance airing on SiriusXM Hits 1 (ch. 2) on Thursday, December 17 at 6pm ET, Friday, December 18 at 8pm ET, Saturday, December 19 at 4pm ET and Sunday, December 20 at 9am ET. Starting Friday, December 18, select songs will also air on The Pulse, Mosaic, Unwell Music and The Coffee House, and the concert will also be available anytime on the SiriusXM app.


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the show presented by *REESE’S -* click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/alexwarrennyctixPR) for full details. If you do not live in the New York City area, you can also enter for your chance to win a VIP trip to the concert - click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/alexwarrennyctripPR) for full details. At the show, *REESE’S* will treat fans to a flavorful on-site experience with exclusive surprises, giveaways and product sampling.


SiriusXM and Pandora have been early supporters of Alex Warren, selecting him as an Artist Accelerator in 2024, a program which develops and breaks new artists by leveraging the massive audience of both platforms. Since then, Alex has emerged as one of the biggest stars and the singer-songwriter has connected deeply with listeners through his songwriting and inspiring life story. SiriusXM first began spotlighting the rising artist in 2022, with SiriusXM Hits 1 featuring him and his initial songs on its “Hits 1 Verified” and “HITBOUND” shows. SiriusXM’s The Pulse was also early to air his music that year and featured Alex’s first-ever radio interview in 2023. Additionally, his music was programmed across Pandora’s biggest flagship stations, including Today’s Hits, Pop Space, and Afterglow.


Alex Warren’s show continues SiriusXM’s exclusive ongoing Small Stage Series featuring performances with premier artists spanning music genres and styles held in small iconic venues. SiriusXM launched its Small Stage Series in August 2021 and to date has included performances by artists including Alicia Keys, Brandi Carlile, Coldplay, Dave Matthews, Ed Sheeran, Green Day, H.E.R., Hilary Duff, J Balvin, J. Cole, Jason Aldean, Kane Brown, Kenny Chesney, Lainey Wilson, Ella Langley, Gracie Abrams and more.


Eligible customers can get their first three months of SiriusXM for free. Click[here](https://siriusxm.com/Get3mosFree) to sign up and experience all that SiriusXM has to offer. See Offer Details.


###


**About Alex Warren**


After years of grinding to be heard, GRAMMY® Award-nominated multiplatinum Southern California artist Alex Warren launched himself into the stratosphere with “Ordinary.” The 7x-Platinum single made history. Beyond holding #1 on the *Billboard* Hot 100 and Global 200 EX US chart for 10 weeks and #1 on the UK Songs Chart for 13 weeks, it concluded the year as *“the top-selling song of 2025* . *”* Moreover, it logged a record-breaking 16 weeks at #1 on US Pop Radio, achieving *“the longest reign ever on the chart* . *”* Most importantly, it paved the way for his Platinum-certified full-length debut LP, *You’ll Be Alright* . It bowed in the Top 5 of the *Billboard* 200 and yielded a procession of Hot 100 hits, including “Eternity,” “Bloodline” \[feat. Jelly Roll\], “On My Mind” \[feat. ROSÉ\], and “Burning Down” \[with Joe Jonas\] driving over 11 billion streams across his catalogue to date. Along the way, he lit up the stages of the *American Music Awards* , *MTV VMA* , and GRAMMY® Awards as well as *The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon* . Beyond unforgettable performances with Ed Sheeran at *Coachella* and Jelly Roll at *Stagecoach* , he headlined sold-out arena tours worldwide. Long before the broken records, scores of awards, and earth-shattering success, Alex was affectionately known to his late father as *“Wildchild* . *”* He did anything he could to defy gravity. He scaled the tallest trees possible, or he’d vault through the air across the playground. In 2026, there’s still nothing that can keep him on the ground. He’s quietly beaten the odds, penned life-changing songs, and found a place in the hearts of millions worldwide. Now, the GRAMMY® Award-nominated multiplatinum artist tells his story on his aptly titled second full-length offering, *WILDCHILD* \[Atlantic Records\]. Musically, it bursts through the clouds with sky-high pop hooks, widens the aperture with cinematic soundscapes, and recharges spirits with the raw energy of a songwriter with nothing to prove and only truth in his heart.


**About Sirius XM Holdings Inc.**

SiriusXM offers live, on-demand, and human-curated programming across music, talk, news, sports, and podcasts, and the company reaches approximately 255 million monthly listeners across its platforms.
